Cash Back FAQs
How do I earn Cash Back?
Start at Rakuten and choose a store. Activate Cash Back to start shopping. Once you make an eligible purchase, we’ll add Cash Back to your account.Learn more
When will I get paid?
We’ll send your Cash Back payment via the method you choose every three months. To get paid, make sure you add your address and earn at least $5.01.Learn more
Is everything eligible for Cash Back?
With Rakuten, you can earn on almost everything. Some stores exclude certain items, categories or brands from earning Cash Back. Stores can also set different Cash Back rates depending on the item category.Learn more
